pages.html:
Alex Rivera

Alex Rivera

Full-Stack Developer & Digital Solutions Architect

Crafting innovative web applications and scalable solutions for forward-thinking organizations.

About Me

I'm a passionate full-stack developer with over 8 years of experience building robust web applications, cloud infrastructure, and digital solutions. My background spans startups and established tech companies, where I've led projects from concept through deployment and beyond.

I thrive in collaborative environments and am committed to writing clean, maintainable code. My approach combines technical excellence with a deep understanding of business needs, ensuring every solution delivers real value.

When I'm not coding, you'll find me contributing to open-source projects, mentoring junior developers, or exploring the latest advancements in web technology.

Skills & Expertise

Frontend Development

  • React & Vue.js
  • TypeScript
  • HTML5 & CSS3
  • Responsive Design
  • Web Performance Optimization

Backend Development

  • Node.js & Express
  • Python & Django
  • RESTful APIs
  • Database Design
  • Authentication & Security

DevOps & Cloud

  • AWS & Azure
  • Docker & Kubernetes
  • CI/CD Pipelines
  • Linux Administration
  • Infrastructure as Code

Databases

  • PostgreSQL & MySQL
  • MongoDB
  • Redis
  • Query Optimization
  • Data Modeling

Tools & Methodologies

  • Git & GitHub
  • Agile & Scrum
  • Test-Driven Development
  • Jira & Confluence
  • Technical Leadership

Soft Skills

  • Project Management
  • Team Leadership
  • Communication
  • Problem Solving
  • Client Relations

Work Experience

Senior Full-Stack Developer

TechVision Solutions | San Francisco, CA | 2021–Present

Leading the architecture and development of a microservices-based platform serving 50,000+ active users. Mentoring a team of 5 junior developers and establishing best practices for code quality and testing.

  • Reduced API response time by 60% through database optimization and caching strategies
  • Implemented comprehensive CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and Docker, reducing deployment time from 2 hours to 15 minutes
  • Designed and deployed scalable Kubernetes infrastructure on AWS, reducing infrastructure costs by 35%
  • Led migration from monolithic architecture to microservices, improving team velocity and deployment frequency

Full-Stack Developer

NextGen Digital | Seattle, WA | 2018–2021

Developed and maintained 15+ web applications for clients in finance, healthcare, and e-commerce sectors. Collaborated with designers and product managers to deliver user-centric solutions.

  • Built a real-time analytics dashboard using React and WebSockets, processing 1M+ events daily
  • Developed RESTful APIs using Node.js and PostgreSQL serving 100+ enterprise clients
  • Implemented automated testing suite increasing code coverage from 45% to 92%
  • Mentored 3 junior developers, conducting weekly code reviews and technical training sessions

Junior Developer

StartupHub Inc. | Austin, TX | 2016–2018

Contributed to the development of multiple SaaS applications in a fast-paced startup environment. Built frontend components and backend endpoints for customer-facing features.

  • Developed responsive UI components using React, improving user engagement by 28%
  • Created and optimized database queries, improving application load times significantly
  • Participated in agile ceremonies and contributed to product roadmap discussions
  • Resolved 150+ bug reports and implemented feature requests with minimal oversight

Education

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Portland | 2016

Graduated with honors. Coursework focused on software engineering, databases, and web development. Completed capstone project building a full-stack attendance tracking system.

Let's Connect

I'm always interested in discussing new opportunities, collaborating on exciting projects, or simply connecting with fellow developers. Feel free to reach out.

Email: alex.rivera@example.com

Phone: (555) 123-4567

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/alexrivera

GitHub: github.com/alexrivera
